title: Level 5 (World Class) - C-8
notes:
West leads the ♦Q against 6♥. After winning West's diamond opening lead in dummy South can guarantee the contract by playing for an elimination, provided that West has the ♠K (a certainty given his 1♠ overcall).

South draws trump and cashes dummy's remaining diamond winner. South crosses in clubs and ruffs a diamond in the dummy to eliminate that suit. South leads a second club toward the closed hand with the intention of playing the ♣10 unless East follows with the ♣Q or ♣J. The contract will be easy unless West is able to win this trick and return the suit while East discards (otherwise either the ♣10 will win, clubs will be 3-3, or West will be endplayed).

South can now run the hearts (having been careful to leave a trump entry to the South hand). When South leads his last heart, West will be squeezed in spades and clubs. The contract is guaranteed regardless of the distribution of the East-West cards (assuming West has the ♠K) by playing in this manner.
